name: dbd-build-tool
description: Web app pour créer, sauvegarder et analyser des builds Killer Dead by Daylight.
author: Thomas701

scripts.build: npm run build:data && npm run build:app
scripts.test: npm run build:data && node --test dist/tests/import.test.js dist/tests/catalog.test.js dist/tests/build-calculator.test.js dist/tests/build-repository.test.js dist/tests/statistics-mmr.test.js dist/tests/statistics-analysis.test.js dist/tests/assistant.test.js dist/tests/cloud-workspace.test.js dist/tests/cloud-statistics.test.js dist/tests/community.test.js scripts/app-updater.test.mjs scripts/start-app.test.mjs scripts/codex-assistant-provider.test.mjs scripts/dbd-statistics-provider.test.mjs scripts/local-data-files.test.mjs scripts/openai-assistant-proxy.test.mjs scripts/vite-config.test.mjs scripts/statistics-extension.test.mjs scripts/migrate-local-data.test.mjs scripts/remote-statistics.test.mjs
scripts.check: npm test && npm run import:data -- --check && npm run audit:analysis && npm run build:sync && npm run build:app
scripts.build:site: npm run build:app && npm run build:extension
